column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Because of you, something horrible happened to me!
I didn't do anything though.
I ran into Kuroneko and Saori earlier. But since you turned them down, I thought seeing you shopping here would've been bad, so I made an excuse.
Oh?  How smart of you.
And then somehow they said I was a trap?  And because I was being helpful carrying these women's stuff, it looked like I was buying them...
Huh? Trap...? Huh?
That's when a guy tries to look like a girl...
What the...
I mean, how did I become like that, is what I'm asking...
...Don't develop that kind of a hobby with those two behind my back.
Eh?  What are you saying?
If you're into that, you can just do them with me! Got it?!
D-Don't go there! It was for your sake that I was misunderstood, right?
Oh, talking back to me, huh? Well, see if I care!
Ah! Hey, Kirino!
Just what was that...
Oh, a phone call.
Yes, hello?
Kyousuke? It's me.
Gah! Dad!
Doing such indecent things with your own little sister's friends. Have you no shame as a man?
W-What did I do?!
I heard it all from Kirino. Come back home immediately. Along with that women's clothing hobby, I'll be giving you a severe scolding.
N-n...! No, that's... Dad... Oh, he hung up.
So Kirino told Dad the stuff I said? And then even explained the part about a 'trap'?!
Why?! Why did she do that? Dammit! I don't know what my sister was thinking!
